ai.title: AI
ai.cmd.smartAdd: Smart add: several tasks from text
ai.claude.connected.hint: The smart features use Claude: understanding instructions, checking photos, answering questions.
ai.claude.not_configured.hint: Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the server to turn on the smart features. Voice and typed tasks still work with simple rules.
ai.claude.fake.hint: Test mode: answers are made up on the server, nothing is sent to Claude.
ai.claude.blocked.hint: The platform paused AI for this company. Write to support to turn it back on.
ai.claude.budget_reached.hint: This month’s AI budget is spent. Raise it in Settings › AI, or wait for next month.
ai.claude.unavailable.hint: Claude isn’t answering right now. The simple rules take over until it’s back.
ai.speech.ready.hint: Voice messages are turned into text on the server.
ai.speech.not_configured.hint: Speech recognition isn’t set up on the server, so voice messages can’t be read yet. Typed instructions still work.
ai.speech.fake.hint: Test mode: every voice message reads as a sample instruction that names real people from your team.
ai.agents.title: AI agents
ai.agents.description: Agents take routine work off your hands: they turn voice messages into tasks, watch deadlines, send heads a morning plan and check proof photos.
ai.agents.emptyBody: When the server has AI agents, they show here.
ai.agents.needsClaudeBody: Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the server and it can be turned on.
ai.agents.needsSpeechBody: Set up speech recognition on the server (AI_SPEECH_URL) and voice messages can be read.
ai.agents.photosNote: When a task with photo proof is finished, its photo goes to Claude, which leaves a note for whoever checks the work.
ai.agents.onlyOwner: Only the owner, or someone allowed to set up AI, can change these.
ai.agents.settingsHint: Budget, what the AI may read and how long voice notes are kept:
ai.agent.title: Agent
ai.agent.notFoundBody: It may not work for this company, or the link is old.
ai.agent.aiOffOwner: Turn on AI on the Agents page, and this agent starts working.
ai.agent.scene.label: {name}: {state}
ai.agent.scene.idle: on, waiting for its next job
ai.agent.line.done: Finished: {n} actions | Finished: {n} action | Finished: {n} actions
ai.agent.kpi.tokensHint: In / out · {n} calls | In / out · {n} call | In / out · {n} calls
ai.agent.kpi.costHidden: Only people who set up AI see it
ai.agent.log.callsHint: The latest 30. Only the model, tokens and timings are kept: no prompt or answer text.
ai.agent.log.neverRanBody: After its first run, each one shows here: when, how long, what it did and how many tokens it used.
ai.agent.log.noSchedule: This agent doesn’t run on a schedule
ai.agent.log.noScheduleBody: When it works: {when}. Its Claude calls are below.
ai.agent.log.noCallsBody: When the agent calls Claude, each call shows here.
ai.agent.log.noCallsRules: This agent does most of its work with simple rules. When it calls Claude, each call shows here.
ai.agent.log.noCallsKey: Claude isn’t connected: until a key is added, the agent doesn’t call Claude or use tokens.
ai.agent.tokens.chartHint: The last 30 days, in the company’s time
ai.agent.tokens.empty: No tokens used in the last 30 days
ai.agent.tokens.noKey: Until a key is added, agents don’t call Claude or use tokens. Voice and typed tasks keep working with simple rules.
ai.agent.next.offBody: Once it’s on, what it does next shows here.
ai.agent.next.emptyBody: Its next runs and what it waits for show here.
ai.agent.done.emptyBody: When the agent works, what it did shows here: who it told, which tasks it made.
ai.agent.done.emptyOff: The agent is off. Once it’s on, what it does shows here.
ai.agent.settings.noneBody: This agent works on its own: it can only be switched on or off.
ai.agent.settings.aiOff: AI is off: these can be changed once AI is on.
ai.turnOn.title: Turn on AI agents
ai.turnOn.body: They do the routine for you, in the bots your team already uses. You can turn each one off, or all of AI, at any time.
ai.turnOn.point.voice: A voice message to the bot becomes tasks for the right people
ai.turnOn.point.deadlines: Late work is reported to whoever gave it, once
ai.turnOn.point.morning: Heads get a short plan of their team’s day each morning
ai.turnOn.terms: I agree to the AI terms
ai.turnOn.termsBody: Task texts and voice messages are sent to AI services (Anthropic Claude and speech recognition) only to do this work. Salaries are never shared unless you allow it.
ai.turnOn.termsNeeded: Tick the box to agree to the terms first.
ai.turnOn.later: You can turn it off in Settings › AI.
ai.turnOn.doneBody: The agents that are on by default have started.
ai.off.title: AI is off for this company
ai.off.body: The owner can turn it on in AI › Agents.
ai.key.title: Claude isn’t connected yet
ai.key.body: Voice and typed tasks already work with simple rules. Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the server to turn on the smart features: better understanding, photo checks and Ask AI.
ai.budget.reachedTitle: This month’s AI budget is used up
ai.budget.reachedBody: The smart features rest until next month; simple rules keep voice tasks working.
ai.activity.title: Activity
ai.activity.description: Everything the AI agents did, as it happens.
ai.activity.emptyAgent: This agent hasn’t done anything yet
ai.activity.emptyBody: When the agents work, what they did shows here: tasks made from voice, late work reported, morning plans sent.
ai.voice.title: Voice notes
ai.voice.description: Who said what, what the AI understood and which tasks it became.
ai.voice.emptyBody: Send a voice message to the bot, or press Dictate: what was said and the tasks it became will show here.
ai.voice.tasksFound: {n} tasks found | {n} task found | {n} tasks found
ai.voice.tasksMade: {n} tasks created | {n} task created | {n} tasks created
ai.voice.created: {n} tasks created | {n} task created | {n} tasks created
ai.voice.discarded: This note was discarded: no tasks were created.
ai.voice.expired: Nobody created the tasks within a day, so this note expired.
ai.dictate.title: Dictate tasks
ai.dictate.description: Say who should do what and by when. The AI turns it into tasks for you to check.
ai.dictate.privacy: Only you can create the tasks.
ai.dictate.offOwner: Turn on AI in AI › Agents first.
ai.dictate.noVoice: Speech recognition isn’t set up yet, so type the instructions instead.
ai.smartAdd.title: Smart add
ai.smartAdd.description: Write several instructions at once. The AI splits them into tasks for you to check.
ai.smartAdd.label: Instructions
ai.smartAdd.hint: Name the person and the time: “Alisher, check the fridge temperature by 10 tomorrow and send a photo. Bekzod, count the till tonight.”
ai.smartAdd.placeholder: Who should do what, and by when…
ai.newTask.hint: Several tasks at once? Say or write them in your own words.
ai.recorder.hint: Name the person, the work and the time; several tasks at once is fine. Up to {max}.
ai.recorder.exampleText: “Alisher, check the fridge temperature by 10 tomorrow and send a photo. Bekzod, count the till this evening.”
ai.recorder.listening: Listening. Press Done when you’ve finished.
ai.recorder.useBot: Or send a voice message to {bot}
ai.recorder.useBotGeneric: You can also send a voice message to the bot in Telegram.
ai.recorder.denied.title: The microphone is blocked here
ai.recorder.denied.body: Allow the microphone for this page in the browser’s settings, or type the instructions instead.
ai.recorder.unsupported.title: Recording isn’t possible here
ai.recorder.unsupported.body: This browser can’t record sound. Type the instructions instead.
ai.recorder.error.title: Couldn’t start recording
ai.recorder.error.body: Something stopped the microphone. Try again, or type the instructions instead.
ai.working.uploadBody: Your words are on their way.
ai.working.thinkingBody: Finding who should do what, and by when.
ai.working.later: You can close this: the result waits in Voice notes.
ai.slow.title: This is taking longer than usual
ai.slow.body: The AI may still be working. Try again in a moment, or find the result later in Voice notes.
ai.error.title: That didn’t work
ai.error.speech_unavailable: Speech recognition isn’t set up on the server yet. Type the instructions instead.
ai.error.audio_unreadable: This recording couldn’t be read. Try again, a little closer to the microphone.
ai.error.nothing_heard: Nothing was heard. Try again and speak a little louder.
ai.error.ai_unavailable: The AI isn’t available right now. Try again in a minute.
ai.error.expired: This note expired: nobody created its tasks within a day.
ai.refusal.audio_too_long: The recording is too long. Keep it to two minutes.
ai.refusal.audio_too_big: The recording is too large to send.
ai.refusal.audio_unreadable: This recording couldn’t be read. Try again.
ai.refusal.text_too_long: That’s too much text at once. Keep it under 2,000 characters.
ai.refusal.ai_off: AI is off for this company.
ai.refusal.limit_reached: That’s today’s limit of instructions. Try again tomorrow.
ai.refusal.network: No connection. Check the internet and try again.
ai.review.title: Check the tasks
ai.review.description: Change anything before the tasks are created.
ai.review.none: No tasks were found in this. Try saying who should do what.
ai.review.create: Create {n} tasks | Create {n} task | Create {n} tasks
ai.problem.noMatch: Nobody called “{guess}” was found. Who should do it?
ai.problem.noMatchUnknown: It isn’t clear who should do it.
ai.problem.ambiguousUnknown: Several people could be meant. Choose one.
ai.problem.notAllowed: You can’t give tasks to this person: {name}.
ai.done.title: {n} tasks created | {n} task created | {n} tasks created
ai.done.body: The people got them in the bot, with the usual reminders.
ai.chat.title: Ask AI
ai.chat.description: Ask about your team in plain words: the AI looks through tasks and people for you.
ai.chat.hello: What would you like to know?
ai.chat.helloBody: The AI answers from your company’s own data, within what you’re allowed to see.
ai.chat.suggest.best: Who finished the most tasks this week?
ai.chat.suggest.fridge: Was the fridge temperature checked today?
ai.chat.suggest.review: What is waiting for my check?
ai.chat.checked: Looked at {n} things | Looked at {n} thing | Looked at {n} things
ai.chat.disclaimer: The AI can be wrong: names and tasks in the answer open the real records.
ai.chat.error.generic: Couldn’t get an answer. Try again.
ai.chat.teaserBody: Ask about your pharmacy in plain words: who is late, what waits for a check, how the fridge checks went. The answers link to the tasks and people they mention.
ai.chat.teaserKey: Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the server and Ask AI turns on by itself.
ai.chat.teaserOff: Turn on AI first, then connect Claude on the server.
ai.chat.teaserSoon: Ask AI arrives with the next server update.
ai.chat.unavailableBody: It turns on once the owner connects Claude.
ai.settings.title: AI
ai.settings.on: The agents work for this company.
ai.settings.offBody: Every agent stops, and voice messages are no longer turned into tasks. Tasks already created stay as they are.
ai.settings.budgetHint: What Claude may cost this company a month. When it’s spent, the smart features rest until next month.
ai.settings.share_task_text.hint: Titles, descriptions and comments, to understand and check the work.
ai.settings.share_finance.hint: Sales, expenses and the till, for questions about money.
ai.settings.share_salaries.hint: Pay and bonuses. Off unless you allow it.
ai.settings.retentionHint: Recordings are deleted after this; transcripts and tasks stay.
ai.settings.dailyHint: A limit against mistakes and misuse.
ai.settings.blockedTitle: AI is paused by the platform
ai.settings.blockedBody: The platform paused AI for this company. Write to support to turn it back on.
ai.kpi.week: {n} this week | {n} this week | {n} this week
ai.agents.comingBody: Voice and typed tasks already work: press Dictate or Smart add. The agents that work by themselves arrive with the next server update.
ai.voice.audioGone: The recording was deleted after the retention period; the transcript and tasks stay.
ai.buddy.ready: The agents are ready for work
